label: Settling vertices in order of distance
section: Settling vertices in order of distance
subgoals: Set the source distance to 0 and all others to infinity
Settle the unsettled vertex with the smallest tentative distance
Relax every edge of the settled vertex

label: Tentative distances during the run
subgoals: Read tentative distances as upper bounds that only decrease
Lower a tentative distance when a cheaper route is relaxed
Break ties by an explicit rule so results are reproducible

label: Data structures and limits
subgoals: Use a binary heap for O((V + E) log V) time
Use a bucket queue for small integer costs
Switch to Bellman-Ford when any edge cost is negative
